question: What will come in place of ? to satisfy the equation : (√5-1)² = ?-2√5
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Expand the left side mentally using the formula (a − b)² = a² + b² − 2ab.

(√5 − 1)² = 5 + 1 − 2√5 = 6 − 2√5

Comparing 6 − 2√5 with ? − 2√5 directly gives ? = 6.

**∴ The correct answer is 6.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

(√5 − 1)² = ? − 2√5

**Formula Used:**

(a − b)² = a² − 2ab + b²

**Calculations:**

⇒ (√5)² − 2 × √5 × 1 + 1² = ? − 2√5

⇒ 5 − 2√5 + 1 = ? − 2√5

⇒ 6 − 2√5 = ? − 2√5

⇒ ? = 6

**∴ The correct answer is 6.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Algebraic Identity (a + b)²

The square of a sum is given by (a + b)² = a² + 2ab + b².

Difference of Squares

The product of the sum and difference of two terms is given by (a + b)(a − b) = a² − b².

Properties of Surds

When a square root is squared, it results in the original number: (√a)² = a. Multiplication of surds follows √a × √b = √(ab).
